meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把设计元素变成动态短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字、数据或标识快速做成短小吸睛的动画片段
copy.tagline_en: Turn design elements into short motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want quick animated visuals for social posts or presentations.

howto.what: Claude会规划并制作短篇设计型动态图形：先分析需求、搜索或跳过素材，设计镜头，用现成组件拼装，再检查快照并渲染成MP4或透明背景视频。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作约10秒内、无旁白、以动效为核心的设计型动态图形（如动态文字、统计数字、图表、地图标注、品牌标志动画等）时触发。

say.text: 把这个标题做成冲击力强的动态文字，长度8秒。
say.note: Claude会生成动态文字动画并渲染MP4。

say.text: 把这份销售数据做成柱状图动态演示，配数字滚动。
用这个logo做品牌sting，透明背景，时长5秒。
say.note: Claude会生成透明背景的视频。

howto.what_en: Claude plans and produces short design-led motion graphics: analyzes the request, sources or skips assets, designs shots, assembles from reusable components, verifies with snapshots, and renders to MP4 or transparent-background video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a short (under ~10s), unnarrated, design-led motion graphic such as kinetic typography, stat count-ups, charts, map highlights, or logo stings.

say_en.text: Make this headline a punchy kinetic-type animation, 8 seconds long.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a kinetic typography video as MP4.

say_en.text: Turn this sales data into an animated bar chart with counting numbers.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a data-driven chart animation.

say_en.text: Create a logo sting with this logo, transparent background, 5 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will render a transparent-background video.
